title: The Rusted Titan
text: A war machine the size of a tower lies on its side in the slag, rusted solid, its great hands clawing at the earth. Its plates are scarred with old wounds. Deep in its chest, its heart still glows, and pulses, slow as sleep.

options.label: The strongest pries out the titan's heart while it still sleeps.

outcomes.text: It comes free, warm as a coal, and the glow goes out of the titan's eyes.

options.label: The cleverest studies how it was made, so the House may make its like.

outcomes.text: Old forge-craft for the House's smiths, and dreams of iron hands for weeks.

options.label: Strip the titan's plates. Iron like that would arm a House.

outcomes.text: Iron, a great deal of it, and the heart pulses a little faster as you work.
